paite: Upa deuhte tai ke'nla, pa bang in thuhilh in; tangval deuhte unaupa bang in;
heading: Gingtute Lam A Timothi Mohpuakna

paite: numei upa deuhte nu bang in; nungak deuhte siangthoutak in sanggamnu bang in thuhilh in.
Meithai, meithai taktakte zahtak in.
heading: Meithaite Saidan Ding

paite: Himahleh meithai kuapeuh in tate leh tute aneih uleh huaite'n amau insung ah Pathian limsakna mohpuakna thei masa uhenla, amau nu leh pate uh kem uhen; hiai lah Pathian mitmuh in ahoih in apom tak ngal a.
Meithai taktak amah kia nutsiat a om in Pathian tung ah lametna anei a, sun leh zan a ngen in athum gige hi.
Himahleh meithai ama nopsakna sung a kipia zaw, adam lai nangawn in asi ahi.
Gensiatbei a a-omtheihna ding un huaite thupiak in pia in.
Himahleh kuapeuh in ama mite a ding angaihtuahsak louh a, ama inkuante khol houh angaihtuahsak keileh ginna azuausan a, gingloumi sang in agilouzaw hi.
Meithai kum sawmguk chiang nuailam hilou, mi khat zi hisa,

thil hoih hih lam a mi phatlohta, atate vaktei khin a, mikhualte na zintun khin a, misiangthoute khe na silta a, mangbangte na dawnzang khin a, thil hoih peuhmah thanuamtak a na hih khin ahihleh meithai a gelh theih ahi.
Himahleh meithai naupang simte zaw gelh ke'n; ataksa lunggulhna un Khrist lam a akipiakna uh athuzoh chiang in pasal neih a-ut nak ua,
aginna masa uh atawpsan ziak un siam louh tang in a-om nak uhi.
Huai lou leng thadah in inn teng ah aban pawt nak ua, thadah kia leng hilou in, thu gen louh ding gen in, kamtam leh mite thilhih lai avai hawmsak nak uhi.
Huchi in meithai naupang simte zaw pasal nei in, tate nei uhenla, insung khosak ngaihtuah le uh, melmapa gensiatna ding lemtang musak kei le uh ka deih hi.
Meithai khenkhat Setan lam naih in apialkheta uhi.
Gingtami numei hiam pasal hiam in methaite nei taleh dawnzang hen; saptuamte hihbuai in om kei hen; meithai taktakte adawnzang theihna ding un.
Saptuam Upa vaihawm hoihte, abik in thugen leh sinsakna a semgimte aleh nih a hih thupi tuak a seh nawn sem hi uhen.
heading: Upate

paite: Laisiangthou in, "Bawngtal in buh achil lai in amuk gak ke'n," achi hi. "Nasemmi loh mu tak ahi," achi nawn hi.
Saptuam Upa hekna zaw theihpih nih hiam thum hiam kam a lou zaw sang ke'n.
Mikhialte mi tengteng ma ah taihilh in, midangte'n leng alautheihna ding un.
Deihsak tuam leh khentuam nei a bangmah hih lou a hiai thute zui ding in Pathian leh Khrist Jesu leh angel teltuamte mitmuh in phatuamngaitak in ka hon theisak hi.
Kuamah tung ah khut nga pah ke'nla, midang khelhna ah leng kikum pah ke'n; kihihsiangthou gige in.
Tui kia dawn ke'nla, na gilpi ziak in leh na hat louh nak ziak in uain neu khakha zang zel in.
Mi khenkhatte khelhna alang gige a, vaihawmna atun nak hi; mi khenkhat khelhnate bel akhonung in ahong kilang hi.
Huchi mah bang in mi khenkhatte thil hoih hih kilang pah a-om a, akilangloute leng sel theih ahi kei hi.
